---
name: Implementation report
about: You implemented any slice of KLM — tell us what you found
labels: implementation, high-value
---

**What you implemented** — emitter / validator / signer; language; which
schemas and ladder levels.

**Reference validator output** — `klm-validate` results against your records
(paste verdicts, not screenshots).

**Ambiguity list** — every place the spec was ambiguous, underspecified, or
plain wrong for your implementation. This list is the most valuable part of
the report; nothing is too small.

**Divergences** — anything your implementation deliberately does differently,
and why.
